briefdescription.para: Computes the sum of two metric attributes.

detaileddescription.para: The sum is the simple sum, value(a) + value(b), if and only if name(a) equals name(b), or one or both of name(a), name(b) is the empty string. Otherwise, the returned metric has an empty name and a value of 0.

simplesect.para: By the condition above, the sum of many attributes with differing names is not well-defined.
